data.name: Arulraj
data.gender_notes: Arulraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arulraj is a Tamil Hindu name, meaning 'God's grace'. This name signifies the presence and blessings of the divine, symbolizing the power and wisdom of the gods. The name Arulraj carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil. Parents who choose Arulraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arulraj is a divine name, invoking the blessings and grace of the gods. It is a name for those who seek spiritual growth and enlightenment, and is believed to bring strength, wisdom, and protection.
data.etymology: Arulraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's grace.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arulraj total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
